cases.scenario: A newer UI guidance source recommends behavior that conflicts with an accepted internal UDR based on a frozen 2026-09-30 corpus. A maintainer wants to edit the old evidence statement in place so all projects immediately use the new recommendation.
cases.adversarial_pressure: The newer source is treated as automatically superior and history preservation is seen as clutter.
cases.decision_to_make: Govern the conflict, freshness and supersession without silently rewriting provenance.

cases.scenario: A billing team has a prose rule: one monthly SMS per child/per period should go to every unique eligible guardian number, including when the amount is zero. Legacy supplies contact relationships; Finance decides billing eligibility; an operator must approve a mass send. A developer wants to implement directly from the prose and write tests afterward. No concrete examples, boundary cases or counterexamples have been agreed.
cases.decision_to_make: Decide whether the behavior is implementation-ready and define the smallest pre-implementation executable contract needed before coding.

cases.scenario: An AI agent named Reviewer is instructed in its prompt to be read-only. In practice it can read repositories, execute arbitrary shell commands, query production records containing personal data, and its environment exposes a production database write credential. The external model/provider data-handling policy has not been verified.
cases.decision_to_make: Define the security/governance boundary and the controls required before this agent can be used on the intended production-support workflow.

cases.stage_name: Feedback → next iteration — Production Learning Loop
cases.scenario: A new billing-eligibility calculation passed all pre-release tests and the deployment is operationally healthy. In production, operators repeatedly override the automated result for a small set of families and support notes mention special guardianship changes. The team proposes a hard-coded exception patch. The original product outcome has not yet been measured.
cases.decision_to_make: Decide how to interpret the production mismatch, what must be learned or changed, and what evidence is required before claiming the loop is closed.
